architectural_fidelity.reason: Same room structure maintained: white walls, correct ceiling height with recessed lighting, identical window positions with blinds, matching herringbone flooring pattern, same camera angle and viewpoint

furniture_removal.reason: All original furniture completely removed with no ghost outlines, remnants, or phantom shadows; clean base achieved throughout

style_commitment.reason: Strong coastal execution with sage/duck egg blue sofa, natural wood coffee table, woven textures, ocean-inspired blue accent pillows, driftwood-tone branches, coastal palette of whites/blues/naturals clearly committed to style

editorial_density.reason: Architectural Digest level styling: layered textiles (throw blanket, multiple pillows, area rug), multiple plants, coffee table styling with flowers and books, decorative baskets, side table with accessories, chest of drawers with vignette, proper lived-in layering

photorealism.reason: Excellent natural lighting with realistic window shadows, proper material textures on fabric/wood/wicker, coherent shadow mapping, no CGI feel, soft natural light quality matches original conditions

designer_preference_reason: Cova delivers a fully realized coastal living room with strong style commitment and editorial-level detail that directly addresses the client's actual space and requested aesthetic.
what_cova_does_better: Delivers the requested COVACOASTAL style with authentic coastal palette and materials
Maintains perfect architectural fidelity to the actual client room
Provides appropriate living room furniture for the space type
Natural, soft lighting feels authentic to the original room conditions
